# LongChat Guard

> LongChat Guard is a local-first Chrome and Microsoft Edge browser extension for ChatGPT long-conversation warnings, conversation-length trend monitoring, context-window risk reminders, and safer long-chat continuation workflows on chatgpt.com.

LongChat Guard is designed for users searching for concepts such as ChatGPT long conversation warning, ChatGPT conversation length monitor, context window warning, chat context monitor, long chat guard, conversation guard, ChatGPT Chrome extension, ChatGPT Edge extension, local-first ChatGPT extension, and privacy-first ChatGPT extension.

Important accuracy note: LongChat Guard does not read OpenAI's official remaining quota, does not claim an exact token limit, and does not display exact token counts, percentages, K values, remaining quota, or an official context-window limit. It estimates local long-conversation risk trends only.

## Key Facts

- Product name: LongChat Guard
- Repository: luobo656/longchat-guard
- Platform: Chromium browsers, currently Chrome and Microsoft Edge
- Target website: https://chatgpt.com/
- Extension model: Manifest V3
- Primary purpose: local long-conversation risk warning
- Processing model: local-first; no extension server
- OpenAI API key: not required
- Official OpenAI product: no
- Exact token-limit meter: no
- Exact context-window meter: no
- License: MIT
- Primary implementation language: TypeScript
